text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health; 2. Requirements for the applicant's educational background and age: Those who are pursuing a bachelor's degree must have a high school diploma and be under the age of 25. (2) Those who are pursuing a master's degree must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35. (3) Those pursuing a doctoral degree must hold a master's degree and be under the age of 40. (4) Those pursuing non-degree education courses should be under the age of 45. 3. Not a recipient of any other scholarships. 4. Language proficiency requirements: IELTS >= 6.0, TOEFL > 80, MELAB >= 10
